title: The Distant Postcards
author: Jonah Thornbury
blurb: Oscar Delacroix, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
